evidence.title: Free Stock Photos and Images - StockSnap.io

name: StockSnap.io
summary: Library of free CC0 stock photos that can be downloaded without attribution for personal and commercial use.
description: StockSnap is a stock photo site whose images are all released under the Creative Commons CC0 license, so they can be copied, modified and redistributed without asking permission or crediting the photographer. Photos are browsable by category and trending tag, signed-in users can favourite them, and photographers can submit their own work for curation.
contains: sitemap lists about 50,000 photo and page URLs
all photos licensed CC0, no attribution required
categories: technology, travel, nature, business, food, wallpapers and more
popular and date sorts plus trending tag pages
free account for favouriting photos and submitting your own
submission guidelines: at least 1920x1280, no borders, text or nudity
no public API; an early-access list is offered by email
weekly newsletter with the most popular photos
